title: What If One Driver Did Every Uber Trip?
description:
What if one driver had to do every Uber trip in a day?

Sources:
- Uber: Uber Announces Results for Third Quarter 2026: https://investor.uber.com/news-events/news/press-release-details/2026/Uber-Announces-Results-for-Third-Quarter-2026/default.aspx

Uber Q3 2026 (Nov 4 2026): 4.1 billion trips in the quarter, up 16%. Trips = Mobility rides plus Delivery orders. Uber: more than 83 billion trips since 2010. Our math: 4.1 billion / 92 days = about 44.6 million a day, about 516 a second; one trip a minute = about 85 years for one day's trips; 83 billion trips at one a minute = about 158,000 years. Not financial advice.

#shorts #uber #whatif #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you tap for a ride, ask yourself:
cta: Uber or a bike? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: What if one driver had to do every Uber trip in a day?
Sounds tough? Uber did 4.1 billion rides and deliveries last quarter.
Then picture it. Hundreds of trips every second.
Just one trip a minute? One day's trips would take 85 years.
Still not done? Every trip ever: 83 billion. About 158,000 years.
